name: Date That JoJo
source:
The story takes place in a weird alternate universe where everyone’s in high school for some reason and you’re best friends with Jolyne. You made a bet with her that you’d be able to get a date before the school day ends. The story and most of the dialogue was written by my sister so it’s gonna be really silly.

[From [url=https://daily-jouta.tumblr.com/post/150283676285/its-finally-done-date-that-jojo-is-a-joke-dating]tumblr[/url]]
